projects.name: SSH Honeypot (Graduation Project)
projects.description: Deployed a Cowrie honeypot on an Ubuntu cloud VM, secured management access with iptables, parsed 48,000 login attempts using Python to identify common credentials and post-login commands, cross-referenced top 500 source IPs with reputation feeds (71% identified as scanners), mapped attacker behavior to ATT&CK techniques, and presented a 40-page report to the department committee.

projects.name: Web Application Weaknesses Lab
projects.description: Identified and exploited SQL injection and stored XSS vulnerabilities in a vulnerable shop application using Burp Suite, documented fixes, and ran Nmap and Nessus scans against a lab subnet, ranking 23 findings by CVSS score.

projects.name: Suspicious Attachment Teardown
projects.description: Analyzed a macro-enabled Word document in an isolated VM, extracted a hidden PowerShell downloader, and listed the domains it contacted.
